summary: vLLM wheels require CUTLASS DSL 4.7.1, the compiler B12X and FlashInfer now use
compatibility: No user action required. The first start after updating compiles B12X kernels again for the new compiler.
details: B12X moved to CUTLASS DSL 4.7.1. The runtime image keeps one compiler for B12X, FlashInfer and vLLM, so vLLM's wheel metadata now names 4.7.1 instead of 4.6.2.
